metaDescription: Brand custom backpack folding chairs for events and giveaways. Order bulk with Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Backpack folding chairs combine portable seating with hands-free carrying, making them ideal for outdoor corporate events, team-building days, and trade show giveaways. Unlike standard folding chairs, these models feature built-in backpack straps and often include insulated coolers or storage pockets. The KOOZIE® Backpack Cooler Chair is a popular example, offering both comfort and convenience. Customize with your logo via screen printing or embroidery for a practical branded giveaway that attendees will use again and again.
heroAltText: Custom backpack folding chairs with logo, portable seating for outdoor events and tailgating
